title: Majestic 12 committee

tellings.quote: rumored sort of committee around this in the UFO topic called the Majestic 12.
Allegedly, the Majestic 12 was a secret committee formed by President Truman in 1947 to handle the extraterrestrial issue.
tellings.difference: Says Truman formed it in 1947 and credits Bush, Gray, Menzel and Eisenhower, where the story gives no date or founder.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of the Majestic 12 secret committee on the UFO issue. This telling adds that Truman formed it in 1947.

tellings.quote: fictitious is the Majestic 12 committee he was rumored to be appointed to by President Truman, an elite group of scientists, military and intelligence officials who directly advised the [music] president on UFOs.
tellings.difference: Says Truman appointed it, names Twining as a rumoured member and describes it as scientists, military and intelligence officials advising the president.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about the rumoured Majestic 12 committee that advised on UFOs.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, mentions a rumored secret committee in the United States known as Majestic 12. As he puts it, it is talked about in UFO circles as a group connected to the subject, though he gives no dates or details. If such a group existed, it would mean someone in government was quietly overseeing the UFO question.
